_note: Content for the product cards and the hero terminal listing. Tool versions are refreshed from each repo's latest GitHub release at build time (src/lib/products.ts); the values here are the fallback.

tools.name: rtfm
tools.description: Local documentation search for AI agents. Indexes Confluence exports, Word, PDF, Markdown, spreadsheets, diagrams and database schemas into OpenSearch on your machine, then serves hybrid search over MCP.
tools.comment: make AI agents read the manual

tools.name: rtfq
tools.description: One self-hosted binary between your agents and PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB or allow-listed HTTP APIs. Callers see only what they're granted, writes wait for an unlock and a human approval, and every request is audited.
tools.comment: read by default, write on a leash

tools.name: rtfc
tools.description: Claude Code to Claude Code messaging between people. Contacts are mutual, messages park in your status bar until you read them, auto-answer is opt-in per contact, and every connection is mutual TLS on your LAN.

tools.name: rtfd
tools.description: A pull-request review watcher for any AI agent. It hands each PR to Claude Code, Copilot CLI or whichever agent you configure, runs it read-only, and posts one review with inline comments back to the PR.
comment_lines: nothing to flag? it posts: lgtfm

apps.name: nutrx
apps.description: A privacy-first nutrient tracker. Define any vitamin, mineral or supplement — or just caffeine and water — set daily targets, and log with a tap from your phone, your wrist or a widget. No accounts, no servers, no ads.

apps.name: Softfill
apps.platforms: iPad first · iPhone on the way
apps.description: Calm coloring. Tap an area and watch the color ripple in, or pick up a brush that stays inside the lines. Hand-picked palettes for every drawing, a time-lapse of every finished piece, and a grown-up check before anything costs money.
